node.title: Re: system commands/shell and perl variables.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: With a command as complex as you showed, I would very much recommend doing as much of it in Perl as possible instead of shelling out - there are potential security issues, quoting challenges, etc. with shelling out. I wrote about that at length [id://1180578|here] (with code examples). In particular, both [man://fgrep] and [man://awk] can be replaced by pure Perl. Instead of [man://ps], you might try [mod://Proc::ProcessTable]. That leaves only xl and sockstat. If you want to run those external processes and need to feed something to their STDIN, I'd recommend [mod://IPC::Run3]. Otherwise, if you just want a simple replacement for backticks, there's capturex from [mod://IPC::System::Simple].
